headline: Romanian Software Group AROBS Doubles Net Profit Over First Nine Months
summary: Romanian technology company AROBS Transilvania Software reported a 100% year-on-year increase in net profit for the first nine months of 2026.
why: AROBS Transilvania Software is an IT solutions and software engineering company listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange.

impacts.why: AROBS doubled its net profit in the first nine months of the year.
